deficiencies.description: The source sentence is grammatically incomplete and unclear about what interferes with what ('the hematopoietic stem cells that are there, these will interfere'). The rewrite resolves this by making the tumour the subject and haematopoietic stem cells the object ('will interfere with them').
deficiencies.sourcePassage: if you have a tumor that is occurring in some of the blood compartments, the hematopoietic stem cells that are there, these will interfere.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A tumour occurring in the blood compartments, where the haematopoietic stem cells are located, will interfere with them.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite inserts 'therefore', asserting a causal link between the niche being small and the interference with the bone marrow, whereas the source text merely juxtaposes the two statements.

deficiencies.rewritePassage: This niche is not very big. The tumour will therefore interfere with the bone marrow,
